doc.title: ZBW–ZDC LOA
doc.summary: LOA between vZDC and Boston Virtual ARTCC: general handoff/datablock rules, direct-to permissions, ZNY-offline direct transfer procedures, combined frequencies, and arrival route/altitude tables in both directions.

items.title: Purpose, scope, disclosure
items.text: Defines pre-defined ATC procedures and coordination between Washington ARTCC (vZDC) and Boston Virtual ARTCC (BVA). Procedures apply unless prior coordination has been effected and apply during the transfer of IFR aircraft. VATSIM use only; not affiliated with the FAA. Cancels the agreement effective 4 August 2021.

items.title: Coordinate all deviations from the LOA
items.text: BVA/vZDC ATC must coordinate and resolve, in the way that gives the pilot the smoothest experience, all deviations from and situations not addressed by the LOA (e.g. non-standard sectorization, holding, pilots unable to accept LOA routes, aircraft above/below LOA altitudes).

items.title: 1X simulation rate before handoff
items.text: Ensure all aircraft are at a 1X simulation rate prior to initiating handoff.

items.title: 10nm in trail, same route and altitude
items.text: Aircraft on the same route segment at the same altitude must be separated by not less than 10 nm (steady or increasing) or another value specified in the LOA, unless greater MIT is requested real-time by BVA/vZDC. NOTE: separation of less than 10 nm is permitted provided the trailing aircraft is operating at a speed that will permit it to overtake the lead aircraft, and both are vertically separated.

items.title: Handoff at least 10nm before boundary
items.text: Handoff requests must be made at least 10nm prior to the relevant airspace boundary unless otherwise specified. Handoff requests may be initiated up to 50nm without prior coordination.

items.title: Resolve conflicts and MIT before handoff
items.text: All conflicts, imminent situations and MIT separation issues must be resolved prior to handoff.

items.title: Clear scratchpads unless conveying info
items.text: Scratchpad entries must be cleared unless required to convey operational information (e.g. "M80" for assigned Mach, "H###" for assigned heading) not coordinated by other means.

items.title: Datablock formatting, A## and NORDO
items.text: Altitude status (assigned/interim) must always reflect the actual/cleared status. Fourth line usage per 7110.65 plus: A## (aircraft approved to step away, expected return time ##) and NORDO (unresponsive to multiple handoff attempts and messaged to contact the new frequency). Aircraft type and equipment suffix must match the aircraft's capability.

items.title: Route per Attachments 1 and 2
items.text: ARTCCs must route traffic as described in Attachments #1 and #2.

items.title: ZBW may clear direct ZJAAY (west of Q167)
items.text: ZBW may clear aircraft direct ZJAAY, west of Q167 but no further west than a line between CCC and SWL.

items.title: ZBW may clear ZIZZI or TBONN east of Q167
items.text: ZBW may clear aircraft ZIZZI or TBONN east of Q167.

items.title: ZDC may clear direct ORW and HTO
items.text: ZDC may clear aircraft direct ORW and HTO without prior approval.

items.title: ZDC: no direct TOPPS/EBONY/ALLEX/QUBIS/MILLS/TAFFY
items.text: ZDC must not route traffic direct TOPPS, EBONY, ALLEX, QUBIS, MILLS, or TAFFY.

items.title: ZNY offline: direct ZBW–ZDC handoffs
items.text: When ZNY is offline, aircraft passing through the New York area to/toward ZBW or ZDC are transferred directly between Boston and Washington Centers. BVA completes the handoff before the ZBW/ZNY border and ZDC before the ZDC/ZNY border, as if to New York Center. ZDC is responsible for separation between tracked aircraft within ZNY airspace while direct handoffs are in place.

items.title: ZNY offline: PHL JIIMS cross 35NE MANTA FL200
items.text: When ZNY is offline, for aircraft destined to PHL on the JIIMS STAR, ZBW must instruct the aircraft to cross 35 miles northeast of MANTA at FL200 and hand off to ZDC prior to the ZNY boundary.

items.title: ZNY offline: BOS ROBUC cross NEWES FL270
items.text: When ZNY is offline, for aircraft destined to BOS on the ROBUC STAR, ZDC must instruct the aircraft to cross NEWES at FL270 and hand off to ZBW prior to the ZBW boundary.

items.title: ZDC combined: GVE32 on 133.72
items.text: ZDC normally operates combined in single-sector mode using the CTL/ATL area GVE32 sector frequency 133.72; a variety of splits may be used when traffic warrants. The sector map shows ZDC sectors such as 05 LDN, 37 MAR, 52 TEC, 32 GVE, 12 BRV, 20 BKT, 36 RDU, 09 DIW, 54 SBY and 59 SIE.

items.title: ZBW combined: BOS_CTR 134.700 (CON37)
items.text: When Boston Center is combined it operates as BOS_CTR on 134.700 (CON37).

items.title: ZBW sector splits published online
items.text: Boston Center splits are coordinated with adjacent facilities using ATC channels; current splits are published at airspace.bvartcc.com.

items.title: DCA jets via ZIZZI ATR LAFLN DEALE: AOB FL340
items.text: DCA jet arrivals via ZIZZI ATR LAFLN DEALE STAR: at or below FL340. DCA/BWI/ADW in trail as one.

items.title: DCA props via T320 VAALI CAPKO: AOB FL280
items.text: DCA prop arrivals via T320 VAALI CAPKO: at or below FL280. DCA/BWI/ADW in trail as one.

items.title: BWI jets via ZIZZI ATR LAFLN MIIDY: AOB FL340
items.text: BWI jet arrivals via ZIZZI ATR LAFLN MIIDY STAR: at or below FL340. DCA/BWI/ADW in trail as one.

items.title: ADW jets via ZIZZI ATR LAFLN SPISY: AOB FL340
items.text: ADW jet arrivals via ZIZZI ATR LAFLN SPISY STAR: at or below FL340. DCA/BWI/ADW in trail as one.

items.title: RIC & Sats via Q167 ZJAAY ARICE JAMIE
items.text: RIC & satellite arrivals routed Q167 ZJAAY ARICE JAMIE. No altitude listed. (RIC satellites not defined in this LOA.)

items.title: ORF & Sats via Q167 ZJAAY CCV
items.text: ORF & satellite arrivals routed Q167 ZJAAY CCV. No altitude listed. (ORF satellites not defined in this LOA.)

items.title: RDU via Q167 ZJAAY TAQLE STAR
items.text: RDU arrivals routed Q167 ZJAAY TAQLE STAR. No altitude listed.

items.title: ZBW arrival groups enter in trail
items.text: Aircraft in each group (Boston; Cape Airports: ACK, HYA, FMH, CQX, PVC, MVY; PVD and Satellites: PVD, EWB, OQU, PYM, SFZ, UUU, GHG) must enter ZBW in trail with their group. The PVD group must be below the Cape Airports group. In-trail sequencing applies between aircraft of similar performance. MVY arrivals may be above other PVD-group airports; ACK arrivals may be above other Cape Airports.

items.title: BOS RNAV jets via Q419 JFK ROBUC: NEWES FL270
items.text: BOS RNAV jet arrivals via Q419 JFK ROBUC STAR: NEWES at FL270.

items.title: BOS non-RNAV jets via J42 RBV J222 JFK ORW
items.text: BOS non-RNAV jet arrivals via J42 RBV J222 JFK ORW STAR: NEWES at FL270.

items.title: BOS non-jets via WOONS or WOONS STAR
items.text: BOS non-jet arrivals route WOONS or WOONS STAR. Non-jet aircraft are not permitted on the ORW or ROBUC arrivals. Altitude: N/A.

items.title: ACK RNAV via Q439 SARDI RIFLE DEEPO STAR
items.text: ACK RNAV arrivals via Q439 SARDI RIFLE DEEPO STAR. Altitude: None.

items.title: ACK non-RNAV via J174 RIFLE DEEPO STAR
items.text: ACK non-RNAV arrivals via J174 RIFLE DEEPO STAR. Altitude: None.

items.title: HYA/FMH/CQX/PVC via RIFLE LIBBE FLAPE MVY
items.text: HYA, FMH, CQX, PVC RNAV arrivals via RIFLE LIBBE FLAPE MVY DCT. Altitude: None.

items.title: MVY via RIFLE LIBBE FLAPE DCT: AOB FL370
items.text: MVY RNAV arrivals via RIFLE LIBBE FLAPE DCT: at or below FL370.

items.title: PVD sats via Q439 HTO JORDN MINNK: AOB FL370
items.text: EWB, OQU, PYM, SFZ, UUU, GHG arrivals (all types) via Q439 HTO JORDN MINNK DCT: at or below FL370.

items.title: PVD via Q439 HTO JORDN STAR: AOB FL370
items.text: PVD arrivals (all types) via Q439 HTO JORDN STAR or HTO JORDN MINNK DCT: at or below FL370.
